mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.req_id, s.name, s.note, s.visibility, s.owner_user_id, s.kind, s.rule_json, s.created_by, s.created_by_user_id, s.created_at, s.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM case_set_item i WHERE i.set_id = s.id) AS case_count FROM case_set s WHERE s.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND s.req_id = #{reqId} AND (s.visibility = 'team' OR s.owner_user_id = #{viewerId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM case_set_member m WHERE m.set_id = s.id AND m.user_id = #{viewerId})) ORDER BY CASE s.visibility WHEN 'team' THEN 0 WHEN 'members' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, s.created_at, s.id

SELECT name FROM case_set WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND req_id = #{reqId} AND kind = 'dynamic' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(rule_json, '$.moduleId')) = #{moduleId} ORDER BY created_at, id
mapper.insert:

mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS setId, s.name AS name, s.kind AS kind, c.latest_status AS status, COUNT(c.id) AS cnt FROM case_set s LEFT JOIN case_set_item i ON i.set_id = s.id AND i.workspace_id = s.workspace_id LEFT JOIN test_case c ON c.id = i.case_id AND c.workspace_id = i.workspace_id WHERE s.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND s.req_id = #{reqId} AND s.visibility = 'team' GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.kind, c.latest_status ORDER BY s.created_at, s.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO case_set (id, workspace_id, req_id, name, note, visibility, kind, rule_json, owner_user_id, created_by, created_by_user_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{reqId}, #{name}, #{note}, #{visibility}, #{kind}, #{ruleJson}, COALESCE(#{ownerUserId}, ''), #{createdBy}, #{createdByUserId})
mapper.update: UPDATE case_set SET name = #{name}, note = #{note}, visibility = #{visibility}, kind = #{kind}, rule_json = #{ruleJson}, owner_user_id = COALESCE(#{ownerUserId}, '') WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM case_set WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
